Overview

Fahaheel is a city in Ahmadi with a population of 80,000. A coastal suburb of Kuwait City in the Ahmadi Governorate, known for its beachfront, seafood restaurants, and oil industry heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 320 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
